title: Framingtopes
authors: Sergio Alejandro Fernandez de soto Guerrero
summary: Framing lattices arise from the dual graphs of framed (or DKK) triangulations of flow polytopes and provide a common framework encompassing classical lattices such as the Boolean, Tamari, and weak-order lattices, as well as $τ$-tilting posets of certain gentle algebras. In this paper, we introduce the \emph{framingtope}, a polytopal complex that provides a geometric counterpart to a framing lattice: its edge graph is the Hasse diagram of the framing lattice.
